title: Towards Inclusive Toxic Content Moderation: Addressing Vulnerabilities to Adversarial Attacks in Toxicity Classifiers Tackling LLM-generated Content
findings: The paper found that toxicity classifiers' vulnerability to adversarial attacks varies across different religious groups (Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Buddhist). The proposed mitigation technique, which involves suppressing specific 'vulnerable' attention heads in the model, improved classification accuracy on adversarial data for these groups. The analysis suggests that biases and vulnerabilities related to specific demographic groups, including religious ones, are structurally encoded within the model and can be traced and mitigated using mechanistic interpretability techniques.
